about: (Noah) the Tablet of Mysteries' donated weapons (docs/TABLET_OF_MYSTERIES.md): worn = one tier above your class sword, battered = two; uses = hits / arrows / casts before it breaks; lost if you fall. model: the weapon's own (tools/tabletweapons.py; the fists have none - they are gloves, tools/tabletgloves.py); show: the model that rises out of the tablet's pool; gloves: the fists' gloves (first-person and third-person models).

rows.label: Stormtalons
rows.power: Glass claws worn on both hands, humming with a storm. Every 3rd hit jumps lightning to 2 more of the dead; a heavy hit stuns the one struck.
rows.owner: Left by a storm-mage who fought with her hands when her magicka ran dry.

rows.label: Gravebell Mace
rows.power: A cracked temple bell on an iron pole. Every 5th hit tolls it, stunning the dead within 5 m.
rows.owner: Taken from a ruined temple of Arkay.

rows.label: Talons of Woe
rows.power: Dragonbone claws worn on both hands. Their bleed runs twice as deep in the dead, and each kill heals you a little.
rows.owner: Cut from the talons of a dragon that fell over Whiterun.

rows.label: Riverstone Halberd
rows.power: A nordic halberd, its haft swollen and green from the river. Its hits knock the dead back; a heavy attack splits the ground in a line before you.
rows.owner: Dragged out of the White River.

rows.label: Wyrmspine Pike
rows.power: A pike of dragon bone. Its thrusts pierce through 2 more of the dead in a line; a heavy thrust drives a spike of bone up out of the ground ahead.
rows.owner: Carved from the spine of the first dragon Alduin raised.

rows.label: Rimewick Quarterstaff
rows.power: A stalhrim quarterstaff with a cold lantern-light caught in its head. Its spins strike like any staff's; a heavy attack that lands throws the light out as an orb that pulls the dead in, then bursts.
rows.owner: Carried by a lamplighter of Riften until the lamps went out.

rows.label: Cinderclaws
rows.power: Daedric claws worn on both hands, still smouldering. Every swipe sets the dead burning; a heavy swipe flings a fan of embers.
rows.owner: Pried from a dremora who walked out of an Oblivion gate.

rows.label: Eclipse Edge
rows.power: A glass pike of a sun half and a moon half. Light thrusts alternate the two; a heavy attack calls a 6-second eclipse that blinds and slows the dead.
rows.owner: Its last bearer saw the sun go out over Sky Haven.

rows.label: The Wandering Star
rows.power: A dim star caught in a cage on a glass staff. Each cast lets it out to bounce between up to 8 of the dead.
rows.owner: Found at the bottom of the College's collapsed well.

look.plugin: Fulcimentum - More Staves and Wands of Skyrim.esp

rows.label: Frostmourn Rapier
rows.power: A rapier of stalhrim, cold to the touch. Its thrusts slow everything they touch; a heavy thrust freezes a ring of the dead around you.
rows.owner: Brought from Solstheim by a duellist of Raven Rock.

rows.label: The Unwritten Codex
rows.power: A spell book with no author. Each cast flips to a chapter - Fire, Frost, Storm or Void - and its glyphs lift off the page into the spell; every 10th cast is a chapter's end: all four at once.
rows.owner: No one remembers who left it. The pages remember everyone.
